title: Academic Writing — Rainwater treatment
description: Academic Task 1 visual report and Task 2 essay. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The diagram shows how rainwater from a school roof is collected and treated for use in toilets.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

items.label: Collect
items.detail: Roof gutters carry rainwater into a downpipe.

items.label: Screen
items.detail: A mesh removes leaves and other large debris.

items.label: Store
items.detail: Water enters a covered underground tank.

items.label: Filter
items.detail: A pump pushes it through a fine filter.

items.label: Distribute
items.detail: A separate pipe supplies the school toilets.

items.label: Release overflow
items.detail: When the tank fills, unused water flows into a soakaway.

tasks.prompt:
New public buildings should be required to collect rainwater. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples.

Write at least 250 words.
